arguments.prompt: Audit the module boundaries in the checked-out repository and write every finding to repo/findings.json as JSON with a stable shape: { "findings": [ { "file": "<repo-relative path>", "severity": "low|medium|high", "note": "<one sentence>" } ] }. Create repo/findings.json yourself; do not only print the findings to stdout. Commit nothing and push nothing. Also leave any long log at .swarmforge/artifacts/audit.log.
